name: @exodra/jsx
_comment_exports: `.` AND `./schema` RESOLVE THE SAME MODULE ON PURPOSE, AND BOTH ARE LOAD-BEARING — do not delete either. `src/` has held nothing but `schema/` since the split, so there is only one type entry; the two specifiers are two ways of naming it and each has consumers the other does not. `./schema` is the SETTING: `jsxImportSource: "@exodra/jsx/schema"` (packages/type-tests/tsconfig.json, scripts/check-doc-examples.mjs, and every tsconfig snippet in the docs), which is why `./schema/jsx-runtime` and `./schema/jsx-dev-runtime` exist below — TypeScript appends `/jsx-runtime` to whatever jsxImportSource names. `.` is the NAME: what `npm install @exodra/jsx` writes, what create-exodra scaffolds into a generated app's dependencies, what scripts/test-packed.mjs imports, and where `exoJsx` is imported from. THE ASYMMETRY THAT BITES: there is deliberately no `./jsx-runtime`, so `jsxImportSource: "@exodra/jsx"` — the bare form — does NOT work, and fails at the tag rather than at the setting. docs-site/build/ still contains that spelling in stale pre-split output.
description: JSX/TSX TypeScript types for Exodra - the namespaced-directive schema dialect
